skaltavern_ale_desc: Cold, golden and honest. A tankard warms you and puts a spring in your step.
skaltavern_honeymead_desc: Sweet, strong and dangerous. The skalds swear it carries songs.
skaltavern_wine_desc: Dark and sharp, pressed from the berries of the Black Forest. Sneaks up on you.
skaltavern_skaldmead_desc: Cloudberry mead brewed for feast nights on the plains. Two of these and the longhouse starts to spin.
skaltavern_drink_note: Getting drunk: a little warms you and gives some stamina; more makes the world sway; too much and you fall.
skaltavern_tipsy_tooltip: The more you drink the more the world sways. A little warms you and gives some stamina; too much slows you down and knocks you over.
skaltavern_hangover_tooltip: A sore head. Stamina and health come back slower for a few minutes.
skaltavern_skal_tooltip: Skal! You raised a cup with friends: stamina and health come back faster, and more with more to drink with.
skaltavern_sober_hangover: You are sober, and your head knows it.
skaltavern_pass_out: The floor comes up to meet you.
skaltavern_toast_alone: Skal! A toast is better with company.
skaltavern_toast_companion: Skal! You drink with your companion
skaltavern_toast_companions: Skal! You drink with your companions
skaltavern_toast_with_companion: Skal! You drink with {0} and your companion
skaltavern_toast_with_companions: Skal! You drink with {0} and your companions
